_comment: Approved media for the site. A video renders ONLY when its src is a same-origin file under /media/, approvedBy and approvedOn are recorded, and captions exist for all eight languages (en, cs, de, fr, es, it, pl, pt) as /media/*.vtt. Until then nothing is emitted. Exception for review only: a Preview build with CAI_VIDEO_PREVIEW=1 (never Production) renders videos with status 'pending-approval' behind a visible 'pending approval' banner and without structured data. 'held' videos never render. No third-party embeds (the CSP and the privacy notice assume none). Files are content-addressed (<name>-<version>.<first 8 hex of sha256>.mp4) and byte-identical to the delivered master: sha256 below is both. Placement and copy: scripts/lib/videos.cjs, scripts/inject-videos.cjs, scripts/i18n/videos/*.json. Review record: docs/media/video-integration-2026-11-27.md.

approvalConditions: Founder accepts the narration 'Agents support finance, operations, risk, compliance and legal work' with the on-page disclosure that every agent is Coming soon.
Founder accepts the illustrative duplicate-invoice finance scenario (labelled 'Illustrative example' in the video and in the disclosure).

heldBecause: Narration 16.7-24.6 s 'extracts the key terms with a quote to the source' and 28.1-35.8 s 'the notice period exactly as written, every notice clause found' conflict with release 1.0.3.6 (INSTALL.pdf section 9a: excerpts are the AI's reading, not copied from or checked against the file; the extraction can miss or misread a clause).
Slides at 16.5-21.5 s and 58.5-61.5 s show an empty box where an arrow glyph failed to render ('SharePoint [] Contract terms', 'Wording [] Calculation [] Review').
Burned caption splits the brand name across cues at 10.5-13.5 s ('... from Colleague' / 'AI runs inside ...').

approvalConditions: Founder accepts the video's '20-30 minutes, prepared environment only, planning estimate' next to INSTALL.pdf's 'about 60 minutes' and the website's 60-90 minutes; the on-page disclosure states 60-90 minutes in total.
Founder accepts that the video says 'keep Daily recompute off during testing' without 'turn it on when you go live' (INSTALL.pdf section 5); the on-page disclosure adds it.

Founder (and counsel, under the Continuous Certification positioning rules) accepts the narration 'From the EU AI Act ... to ISO standards ...' as proposed coverage; the bounded scope cites ISO/IEC 42001 controls only, and the on-screen card reads 'ISO Control Alignment'.

Founder accepts 'deliver qualifying certified updates' and the four objectives (reduce risk, improve audit readiness, manage AI costs, protect your data) with the on-screen and on-page disclosure: Coming soon, proposed coverage, proprietary programme, not independent regulatory accreditation.
